sections.content: Advice often includes both a recommendation and a consequence. Connectors such as porque, para que, así que and si allow the speaker to explain why a solution is advisable and what may happen if it is followed or ignored.

items.spanish: Deberías hablar con él porque así evitarás un problema mayor.
items.english: You should speak to him because that way you will avoid a bigger problem.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que actúes pronto para que no pierdas la oportunidad.
items.english: I recommend that you act soon so that you do not miss the opportunity.

items.spanish: Si sigues este consejo, resolverás el problema con menos esfuerzo.
items.english: If you follow this advice, you will solve the problem with less effort.

items.spanish: Conviene comparar las alternativas, ya que la decisión tendrá consecuencias importantes.
items.english: It is advisable to compare the alternatives, since the decision will have important consequences.

sections.content: A useful B1 recommendation often gives a reason, purpose or consequence. This makes the advice more precise than a simple command.
